PageUtil.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes pagination state by storing the data collection and page size, then deriving total_items and total_pages using ceiling division." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: collection "Input collection whose length can be obtained with len()."
        <REF> page_size </REF>: int "Number of items per page; must be a positive integer for a valid page count."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the data parameter directly to self.data. RESULT self.data]
            [COMMAND Assign the page_size parameter directly to self.page_size. RESULT self.page_size]
            [COMMAND Compute the total number of items as len(data) and assign it to self.total_items. RESULT self.total_items]
            [COMMAND Compute total_pages as (self.total_items + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size and assign it to self.total_pages. RESULT self.total_pages]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PageUtil.get_page:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the slice of data for a one-based page number, or an empty list when the requested page is outside the valid range." get_page]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> page_number </REF>: int "The one-based page number to retrieve."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> page_data </REF>: list "The slice of self.data for the requested page, or an empty list when the page number is invalid or out of range."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND After confirming that page_number is at least 1 and at most self.total_pages, compute start_index as (page_number - 1) * self.page_size. RESULT start_index]
            [COMMAND Compute end_index as start_index + self.page_size. RESULT end_index]
            [COMMAND Return the slice self.data[start_index:end_index]. RESULT page_data]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: page_number < 1 or page_number > self.total_pages]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return an empty list. RESULT empty_page]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PageUtil.get_page_info:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns a dictionary containing the requested page's items and pagination metadata, or an empty dictionary when the requested page number is out of range." get_page_info]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> page_number </REF>: int "The one-based page number to retrieve; valid values are from 1 through self.total_pages inclusive."
        <REF> page_size </REF>: int "Instance attribute self.page_size; the number of items per page."
        <REF> total_pages </REF>: int "Instance attribute self.total_pages; the total number of pages."
        <REF> total_items </REF>: int "Instance attribute self.total_items; the total number of items in self.data."
        <REF> data </REF>: list or sliceable sequence "Instance attribute self.data; the collection from which the page slice is extracted."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: dict "The page_info dictionary with keys current_page, per_page, total_pages, total_items, has_previous, has_next, and data, or an empty dictionary for an invalid page_number."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the zero-based start_index for the requested page as (page_number - 1) * self.page_size. RESULT start_index]
            [COMMAND Compute end_index as the minimum of start_index + self.page_size and self.total_items; this is the exclusive upper bound for the page slice. RESULT end_index]
            [COMMAND Extract page_data by slicing self.data from start_index (inclusive) to end_index (exclusive). RESULT page_data]
            [COMMAND Assemble page_info with current_page = page_number, per_page = self.page_size, total_pages = self.total_pages, total_items = self.total_items, has_previous = (page_number > 1), has_next = (page_number < self.total_pages), and data = page_data. RESULT page_info]
            [COMMAND Return page_info. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When page_number is less than 1 or greater than self.total_pages]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return an empty dictionary {} immediately. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PageUtil.search:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Filters the object's data items by substring presence of the keyword in their string representation, counts the matching items, computes the total number of pages using ceiling division over the page size, and returns a dictionary containing the keyword, totals, and filtered results." search]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> keyword </REF>: str "The substring to search for within the string representation of each item in self.data."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> search_info </REF>: dict "A dictionary containing the keyword, total_results, total_pages, and the filtered results list."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Filter self.data into a list of items where keyword is a substring of str(item), preserving the original item order. RESULT results]
            [COMMAND Set num_results to the length of the results list. RESULT num_results]
            [COMMAND Compute num_pages as integer ceiling division of num_results by self.page_size using (num_results + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size. RESULT num_pages]
            [COMMAND Create search_info dictionary with keys keyword, total_results, total_pages, and results, assigned from keyword, num_results, num_pages, and results respectively. RESULT search_info]
            [COMMAND Return search_info. RESULT search_info]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
